title: Governor of Tripura meets Prime Minister
body_text:
Governor of Tripura, Shri Indra Sena Reddy Nallu met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today in New Delhi. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X; “Governor of Tripura, Shri Indra Sena Reddy Nallu met Prime Minister @narendramodi. @TripuraGovernor” Governor of Tripura, Shri Indra Sena Reddy Nallu met Prime Minister @narendramodi.
